body.text: I am instructed by the people of this town to inform you that we are again the Crown's.
We were {param:months} months outside it. I will not tell you it was a mistake, because they do not think it was, and I would rather write you something true than something comfortable.

What I will tell you is that we are {perception:winter}, and that a man cannot eat a principle. The warehouses are full of what nobody would come and buy. That argument was made to me by people who had made the other one very loudly in the spring.
Nobody marched in here and made us. You should know that, whatever is said in London about your firmness.
I ask one thing, and it is not for me. Do not make them right the second time.

options.text: and it is the best news I have had in a year
and receive the town back into the Crown's peace
and note how long it took you to write it
and shall remember the spring as clearly as you do

tone.hateful: We will speak of the spring another time.
